subject: Request: sandbox credit & trial extension due to integration snag
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@brightline.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Integration snag — request for trial runway and sandbox top-up

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side: we hit an unexpected blocker integrating Redwood with our staging SSO provider. The connector intermittently fails during the token exchange and our dev team is tied up until the vendor rolls a patch (they estimate ~10 business days). That puts our planned POC schedule at risk.

We really like Redwood's latency profile and the demo looked great, but we need a bit more runway to finish engineering work and complete the data migration. Can we request a 60-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up (roughly $2k) so the teams can continue running tests without hitting the quota?

Attached: brief error log and a screenshot of the failing handshake. I can share more logs if helpful.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Director, Platform Integrations
Brightline

Attachment: error-log-20261228.txt (text)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 12:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Integration snag — request for trial runway and sandbox top-up

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the SSO outage; sounds frustrating.

Couple of quick asks so I can get this routed for approval:
- Can you confirm the minimum additional days you need (60 is fine to ask for but we sometimes compromise on 30–45)
- Are you requesting the $2k as one-time sandbox credit or incremental monthly allowance?
- Any timelines on the vendor fix / estimated go-live now?

Looping in Marissa (Customer Success) and Rishi (SE) so they see the log and can advise on whether a short-term config change would unblock you faster. We typically require an internal note for credits and a deal reference (I’ve attached our deal ID in the metadata).

I’ll start the approval conversation internally once you confirm; we should be able to move quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwoodinference.com

From: Sam Park <sam.park@brightline.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Integration snag — request for trial runway and sandbox top-up

Hi Evelyn — quick follow up:
- Vendor says patch ETA is 7–10 business days; internal testing and validation will likely add another ~5 business days. Realistic total = ~3 weeks (15 business days).
- We asked for 60 days because there are holidays in the middle and several stakeholders off in early Jan. If it helps, we would accept 45 days as long as credits are applied.
- The $2k would be a one-time sandbox top-up to cover additional runs of our migration scripts and parallel test runs.

If you can do 45 days + $1.5k as a middle ground, that would be great. Otherwise, please escalate and we'll wait for your guidance.

Thanks — attaching the error snippet as promised.

Sam

Attachment: error-log-20261228.txt (again)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Integration snag — request for trial runway and sandbox top-up

Evelyn / Rishi — quick internal note from CS perspective:
- Brightline is a mid-funnel POC with clear expansion motion; the deal economics are promising (refer to DEAL-82734).
- Given the holiday overlap and vendor timeline, a 45-day extension + $1,500 sandbox credit is reasonable and keeps the momentum without creating precedent for large, open-ended top-ups.
- If finance needs a short justification, I can flag: "vendor SSO patch + holiday staffing causing integration delay; credit to preserve POC momentum."

If you want, I can draft the email to ops/finance and request a DocuSign amendment for the trial end date. I checked the shared drive and pulled the SSO integration guide that may help their devs (attached).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sso-guide.pdf (PDF)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Integration snag — request for trial runway and sandbox top-up

Hi Sam — good news. We approved the compromise:
- Trial extension: 45 days from your original trial end date (internal note attached to DEAL-82734).
- Sandbox credit: one-time $1,500 top-up applied to your sandbox account.

Next steps:
1) You should see the $1,500 credit on your sandbox account within the next hour. If it does not appear, reply to this thread and I’ll escalate to ops.
2) Marissa will follow up with a short confirmation email and a DocuSign amendment that updates the trial end date so everyone has a record.
3) Rishi offered to have a 30-min troubleshooting session with your engineering lead to walk through the SSO handshake details; he can be available Thursday morning PST if that helps.

Sam — we want to make this as low-friction as possible so your team can validate the POC. If the vendor patch timeline changes, please flag us and we can re-evaluate.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
